inspection_method: Directly inspected all 15 scenes in three six-column overview sheets, four saved eight-panel scene diagnostics, two full LR comparisons, five rectangular LR crops and both statistical charts plus expanded Pipes Z display.
scope_limit: Overview review is not a native-resolution examination of every pixel. Detailed scene selection covers long tails, poor coverage, distant geometry and a comparatively strong baseline example.
findings: Large structures recover in several scenes; fine structures, clutter boundaries and some variants remain fragmented.
Custom LR lowers conditional mean disparity error but loses coverage; retained values are unchanged and invalid-as-bad failure fraction rises.
Rejected pixels include many within 1 px of GT, especially where no right-side comparison is available; right-border loss must not be called proof of bad left prediction.
PianoL and Jadeplant have long disparity error tails and low coverage. Pipes has larger metric errors despite moderate disparity MAE.
GT depth derives from GT disparity. Distance-bin trends also reflect scene/calibration changes; 6+ m only contains dev Pipes.
prior_user_observations: Kept as preliminary history; this review independently reexamined current evidence.

checks.repeat_result: Six CSVs and five existing figures reproduced byte-for-byte; added Pipes display also checked.

implementation_history: git diff from baseline commit shows evaluation/stereo.py only gained compare_lr_rejection; main evaluator unchanged. Current code hashes match the later saved LR analysis.
